messages:
alex: Cutting RC candidate 2027.1 (build: 2027.1-rc3, sha: a1b2c3d). Target promo in the 23:00 UTC change window tonight. Requesting quick sign-offs: @priya (QA), @jordan (infra), @katie (oncall). I'll pin the artifact once we have green on smoke.

priya: quick regression smoke passed in staging except for a ~300ms p50 spike on embedder during heavy sim load. i'll run an extra focused smoke at 22:30 and post results. not a blocker yet but want eyes.

jordan: infra looked good for rc3. i've pre-warmed the cache hosts and reserved extra capacity on the Dedicated pool for the window. request pin to prevent autoscaler churn. rollback image: a1b2b9 (previous prod).

katie: oncall rotation confirmed. we'll be on standby from 22:45 -> 00:30 UTC. if anything noisy, escalate to pager. please add a short runbook entry in the thread.

alex: runbook snippet: 
```
- Trigger: deploy-bot promote --rc=2027.1-rc3 --env=prod --canary=5
- Monitoring: console/rc-dashboard, /alerts/latency-high, token-cost spike
- Rollback: deploy-bot rollback --to-sha=a1b2b9 --env=prod
- Postmortem: create ticket in #incidents if rollback triggered
```

deploy-bot: created RC 2027.1-rc3 and pinned artifact (artifact://redwood/2027.1-rc3). Canary policy set to 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation windows.

repo-bot: merge-freeze enabled for main and release branches until 00:45 UTC. non-critical PRs please wait.

priya: 22:30 smoke: embedder spike not reproduced under focused load. full test battery running (~8m left). I will sign off after load tests.

alex: thanks. reminder: keep thread radio-silent for non-blocking chatter — drop major updates only.

priya: QA sign-off: smoke & load ok. no regressions observed. :white_check_mark:

jordan: infra sign-off: capacity & routing validated, pin confirmed. :thumbsup:

katie: oncall sign-off: standby confirmed, alert thresholds reviewed. :ok_hand:

alex: marking for promo. deploy-bot, proceed with canary.

deploy-bot: starting promotion: canary 5% -> running. will report metrics after 10m.

deploy-bot: canary 5% metrics: latency p95 +2ms, error-rate 0.02% (baseline 0.03%). cost per-token stable. proceeding to 25% after 10m.

deploy-bot: canary 25% -> running. observation window 10m.

oncall-bot: alert thresholds active; no escalations.

deploy-bot: canary 25% metrics: small tail latency bump on one AZ (p99 +40ms). infra routed ~2% of traffic away from that AZ automatically. continuing to 100% after confirmation.

jordan: i pushed a quick AZ filter to routing to reduce tail. observing.

deploy-bot: promoted to 100% traffic. promotion complete. artifact remains pinned for 24h.

alex: promo complete. i've posted release notes draft: <https://internal.redwood/notes/2027.1-rc3>. please add any customer-impact bullets.

priya: added QA notes and the embedder observation (no customer impact).

katie: scheduling follow-up health check at +1h. if anything off, we'll initiate rollback plan.

alex: thanks all. lifting merge-freeze at 00:45 UTC per repo-bot.

repo-bot: merge-freeze disabled.

alex: final: create release ticket and tag the release branch. closing thread. :rocket:
